name: Security Alert Summarizer
headline: Turn vendor advisories + CVE descriptions into one-line exec summaries.
description: A summarization template for security teams. Train a small model to read verbose CVE descriptions, vendor advisories, or threat-intel snippets and emit a single sentence the on-call engineer can scan in 3 seconds. Pattern fits CISO digests, paging-channel summaries, and ticket auto-tagging.
suggested_brief: Train a small model to summarize security advisories into a single sentence: severity, affected component, action. Tone: terse, no marketing language. Never lose the patch-deadline or affected-version detail.
